items.headline: NVIDIA Faces SEC Investigation and Delays Quarterly 10-Q Filing
items.summary: Following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang, NVIDIA is under SEC investigation and has delayed its quarterly 10-Q filing.

items.headline: NVIDIA Co-Founder Jensen Huang Retains Director Nomination Rights
items.summary: NVIDIA co-founder Jensen Huang retains the right to nominate two directors to the company's board.

items.headline: Senator Elizabeth Warren Calls for Breakup of Major Healthcare Conglomerates
items.summary: Senator Elizabeth Warren has publicly advocated for the structural breakup of large healthcare conglomerates, specifically naming CVS Health Corporation as a target for such action.

items.headline: BlackRock's HPS Investment Partners Begins Marketing New Direct-Lending Fund
items.summary: HPS Investment Partners, a firm associated with BlackRock, has initiated the marketing phase for a new direct-lending investment fund.

items.headline: BlackRock Canada Announces November 2026 Cash Distributions for iShares ETFs
items.summary: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited has declared the November 2026 cash distributions for its suite of iShares ETFs.

items.headline: Genomics Ltd. Extends Strategic Drug Discovery Collaboration with Vertex Pharmaceuticals
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals and Genomics Ltd. have extended their long-standing drug discovery and validation partnership for an additional four years.

items.headline: Jeff Bezos Discusses Casting Process for New James Bond Film
items.summary: Amazon executive chairman Jeff Bezos provided insights into the casting of Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, confirming the role of Amazon MGM Studios in the selection process.

items.headline: StackGen Launches Shipyard on Microsoft Marketplace
items.summary: StackGen has made its Shipyard platform available on the Microsoft Marketplace, enabling Azure customers to deploy ephemeral test environments for AI agents and developers.

items.headline: Transamerica Expands AI Partnership with Amazon Web Services
items.summary: Transamerica has deepened its collaboration with Amazon Web Services to scale artificial intelligence across its enterprise operations.

items.headline: BlackRock, Inc. Files Disclosure of Voting Rights in ICG PLC
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported an acquisition or disposal of voting rights in ICG PLC, a UK-based issuer, with the threshold crossed on November 13, 2026.

items.headline: Teamsters Rally Following Amazon's Termination of Delivery Partner
items.summary: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters held a rally in Manhattan to protest the firing of approximately 200 delivery drivers following Amazon's cancellation of a contract with a delivery service p

items.headline: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
items.summary: NVIDIA announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% increase year-over-year.

items.headline: Generation Life Launches ConfidencePlus Annuity with BlackRock Alliance
items.summary: Generation Life has introduced an investment-linked lifetime annuity product, ConfidencePlus, developed in partnership with BlackRock.

items.headline: Broadcom to Invest $1 Billion in Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Broadcom has agreed to invest $1 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering as part of a strategic commitment involving major technology suppliers.

items.headline: Golar LNG Limited Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
items.summary: Golar LNG Limited has declared a cash dividend of $0.25 per share for the third quarter of 2026, payable on December 9, 2026.

items.headline: Golar LNG Limited Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Golar LNG Limited announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting net income of $23 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $56 million.

items.headline: Deutsche Bank Raises Price Target on TransDigm Group
items.summary: Deutsche Bank has increased its price target for TransDigm Group Incorporated from $1,163 to $1,305 while maintaining a 'Hold' rating.

items.headline: Volkswagen Announces New Virtus Sedan for Indian Market
items.summary: Volkswagen India is set to launch the 'New Virtus,' a refreshed version of its premium sedan featuring updated design elements inspired by triangular geometry.

items.headline: Volkswagen and Stellantis Reportedly Considering Partnership with Hongqi
items.summary: Reports indicate that Volkswagen and Stellantis may be exploring potential partnerships with Chinese automaker Hongqi for production within Europe.

items.headline: HSBC Initiates Coverage on INNIO with Buy Rating
items.summary: HSBC has initiated coverage on INNIO N.V. with a Buy rating and a price target of $20.

items.headline: Nippon Yusen K.K. Unveils Ammonia-Fueled Vessel 'Izanami' for Charter to Yara
items.summary: Nippon Yusen K.K. (NYK Line) has unveiled the ammonia-fueled vessel 'Izanami', which is slated to be chartered by Yara upon its completion.

items.headline: Carlyle and KKR Commit Approximately $475 Million to Litmus Music
items.summary: Global investment firm KKR and Carlyle have committed approximately $475 million in new capital to music rights investment and management business Litmus Music.

items.headline: Argus Research Upgrades Elevance Health to Buy
items.summary: Argus Research has upgraded its rating on Elevance Health from "Hold" to "Buy."

items.headline: Mitsubishi Electric Signs First Commercial Launch Contract with PLD Space for MIURA 5
items.summary: Mitsubishi Electric has entered into its first commercial launch agreement with Spanish aerospace company PLD Space to utilize the MIURA 5 launch vehicle.

items.headline: Barclays Upgrades Vimian Group to Neutral
items.summary: Barclays has upgraded its rating for Vimian Group AB from underweight to neutral, while raising the price target to 41 SEK from 29 SEK.

items.headline: Safeture Enters Technology Partnership with Munich Re's Euro-Center
items.summary: Safeture has established a technology services partnership with Munich Re's Euro-Center to enhance its service offerings.

items.headline: Ardagh Metal Packaging Launches €1,250 Million Senior Secured Floating Rate Green Notes Offering
items.summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. has announced the launch of a €1,250 million senior secured floating rate green notes offering to refinance existing debt and support general corporate purposes.

items.headline: Virbac to Participate in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
items.summary: Virbac announced that its CEO and Group CFO will participate in a company presentation and Q&A session at the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London.

items.headline: Skanska Commissions Eqva Subsidiary for Norsk Hydro Project
items.summary: Skanska has engaged a subsidiary of Eqva ASA to perform technical installations at a planned facility for Norsk Hydro.

items.headline: Vusion Unveils 2030 Strategic Growth Plan
items.summary: Vusion has announced a new strategic plan targeting 3 billion euros in revenue by 2030, alongside a downward revision of its 2027 revenue target.

items.headline: Verallia Announces “Verallia Beyond – From Resilience to Acceleration” Strategic Plan
items.summary: Verallia has unveiled its new strategic plan, "Verallia Beyond – From Resilience to Acceleration," during its 2026 Capital Markets Day.

items.headline: Eni's Plenitude Secures Power Purchase Agreement with Orva
items.summary: Eni's subsidiary, Plenitude, has entered into a four-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with the Italian food company Orva to supply 16 GWh of energy.

items.headline: Mycronic Wins US Photomask Repair System Order
items.summary: Mycronic has secured an order for a photomask repair system in the United States valued at up to $3 million.

items.headline: Capgemini Executive Surbhi Dhir Recognized at 2026 Stevie Awards for Women in Business
items.summary: Surbhi Dhir, Head of Financial Services, Banking and Capital Markets at Capgemini, was named a winner at the 2026 Stevie Awards for Women in Business.

items.headline: Scotiabank Partners with Casa for Condominium Payment Rewards
items.summary: Scotiabank has entered a partnership with Casa, allowing ScotiaGold Passport Visa cardholders to earn rewards on condominium payments.

items.headline: BofA Raises Ferrari Price Objective Amid Strong FY27 Visibility
items.summary: Bank of America has increased its price target for Ferrari from 395 to 410 euros, citing strong visibility for the 2027 fiscal year.

items.headline: BNP Paribas Announces Strategic Repositioning of Italian Subsidiary BNL
items.summary: BNP Paribas has unveiled a new strategic plan for its Italian banking arm, BNL, which includes a 20% reduction in branch count by 2030 and a target to achieve a pre-tax return on allocated capital (RO

items.headline: EQT Reportedly Considering Sale of Indira IVF Hospital
items.summary: EQT AB is reportedly exploring a potential divestiture of its majority-owned Indian fertility clinic chain, Indira IVF Hospital.

items.headline: Berenberg Trims Fresenius Medical Care Estimates and Price Target
items.summary: Berenberg analysts have lowered their financial estimates and price target for Fresenius Medical Care, citing anticipated headwinds for the 2027 fiscal year while maintaining a 'Hold' rating.

items.headline: BMW and E.ON Expand Bidirectional Charging Partnership
items.summary: BMW and E.ON have announced the expansion of their bidirectional charging technology to three additional electric vehicle models.
